tokens.name: equinet-color-diagram-line--neutral

tokens.name: equinet-color-diagram-tint

tokens.name: equinet-color-diagram-tint--pale
tokens.usage: Palest background tint in marketing diagrams. Confirmed in all 7 files of the same batch. A cluster of three near-white values remains unresolved: #ECEAEA and #F3F2F2 (both in the ABM infographic) and #F3F3F4 (marketing-brand-ops-agent) are each close to but not identical to this token or to each other.

tokens.name: equinet-color-diagram-surface
tokens.usage: Panel and background fill in system diagrams. Sanctioned 2026-09-23 on cross-file evidence: present in all 5 of the commercial-systems illustration batch. Sits between equinet-color-surface--alt and equinet-color-diagram-tint--pale in luminance. Primarily marketing illustration — but note it also appears in module__2-column-hero-banner.svg, inside that hero's embedded graphic, so the illustration/UI line is less clean than first recorded.

styles.name: h2-canonical
styles.usage: The Figma heading/h2 variable. Unused in all four live-text comps — kept as the canonical definition; use section-heading for real section headings.
